direction.pose_influence: B Big Confidence; preserve E anatomy

purpose: Animation design reference. Generated sheet is illustrative; these numeric specifications govern production sprites. Sheet lettering, colors and pixel alignment are not a machine-validated sprite atlas.

rendering.shading: At most three flat tones per material
rendering.pixel_grid: One shared logical pixel grid for character and props; larger scenes may expand canvas without resizing character
rendering.identity: Pear-shaped E torso, small head, broad horizontal muzzle, low brow, round ears, short legs, broad feet; tail attached to lower back
rendering.confidence: Pose changes only: chin up, chest lifted, planted feet, exaggerated gestures; no anatomy changes
